name: Ask bar to answer
oneLiner: a prompt bar grows out of the brand mark, a question types with a blinking caret, send is pressed with a ring, the bar lifts and the answer lands as the brand's real screen on a glass card turning in 3D
say: when the speaker says what you can ask the product, or 'you just type...': the typing runs under the question, the screen lands as they say what it gives back
